configurations.author_judgment: Do not infer adequacy merely from inactivity. Existing obligations and support must actually remain feasible; a static closed computation is a useful nontrigger for forced evolution.
configurations.cheaper_path: No forced feature growth, cleanup, rewrite, agent or CI service.
configurations.invalidation: Reopen when a consequential obligation, support condition, environment or worthwhile opportunity changes.
configurations.member_semantics: Listed criteria contribute under their individual triggers; membership is neither a serial schedule nor a Boolean conjunction of all mechanisms.
configurations.native_guard: Current obligations, relevant environment and willing support remain adequate; no proposed intervention has justified net value.
configurations.native_operation: Continue useful operation with proportionate revisit observations.

configurations.author_judgment: A local repair can discharge several criteria in one diff and relevant check. C050 supplies only an applicable maintenance/migration profile; its membership does not require running a migration or broad release process.
configurations.cheaper_path: No mandatory taxonomy, board, slicing, mutation campaign, debt register or separate role for each criterion.
configurations.invalidation: Escalate only when scope, observer, intent or recovery assumptions fail.

configurations.native_guard: A bounded fault and adequate local evidence, capability and authority.
configurations.native_operation: One person may use one issue, exact diff and relevant test to correct the fault and release within the actual effect envelope.

configurations.author_judgment: The intended structural change and preserved observer are separate. A good engine name is insufficient, but a directly inspected small transformation need not establish general engine correctness.
configurations.cheaper_path: No catalogue conformity, debt register or general engine certification for a tiny directly inspected output.
configurations.invalidation: Stop or revise when preservation assumptions or payoff fail.
configurations.member_semantics: Listed criteria contribute under their individual triggers; membership is neither a serial schedule nor a Boolean conjunction of all mechanisms.
configurations.native_guard: A future task benefit plausibly exceeds transition cost under valid preservation assumptions.
configurations.native_operation: Use applicable transformations and actual-output checks; review task payoff.

configurations.author_judgment: The native C048 guard is narrower than every possible staged deployment: isolatable exposure, adequate observation and feasible response matter. Shared irreversible writes can defeat the assumed isolation.
configurations.cheaper_path: No fixed canary percentage, universal duration or automatic promotion; no staging where it cannot discriminate.
configurations.invalidation: Failed or absent observation stops the unsupported expansion; shared/irreversible state may require another branch.
configurations.member_semantics: Listed criteria contribute under their individual triggers; membership is neither a serial schedule nor a Boolean conjunction of all mechanisms.
configurations.native_guard: Exposure is isolatable/representative and adverse observations can support feasible action.
configurations.native_operation: Increase exposure only on applicable observations and effect-aware recovery bounds.

configurations.author_judgment: Separate source lines or green individual builds do not establish joint semantic consistency. Conversely a reasoned disjointness argument can remove a particular combination from the relevant set.
configurations.cheaper_path: Retest-all replaces optimisation when cheaper; staging is optional and conditional.
configurations.invalidation: Remove obsolete checks and support paths only after their obligations end.
configurations.member_semantics: Listed criteria contribute under their individual triggers; membership is neither a serial schedule nor a Boolean conjunction of all mechanisms.
configurations.native_guard: Independent changes and consumers make integration feedback consequential.
configurations.native_operation: Permit disjoint work concurrently; check actual interacting combinations and route failures back to relevant decisions.

configurations.author_judgment: Coexistence adds routing, writer authority, data synchronization and eventual closure burdens. No generic dual-write solution or proof of convergence is supplied; compare quiescence and local repair.
configurations.cheaper_path: No universal dual-write design; read-only or single-writer phases may dominate.
configurations.invalidation: Exit only on discharged consumer/data/recovery obligations; replan or abandon when duplication dominates.
configurations.member_semantics: Listed criteria contribute under their individual triggers; membership is neither a serial schedule nor a Boolean conjunction of all mechanisms.
configurations.native_guard: Viable seams and controllable data/version coexistence exist.
configurations.native_operation: Transfer responsibilities with explicit routing/writer authority, reconcile and close or reclassify old paths.

configurations.author_judgment: Quiescence is a stable absence of consequential writes, not a synonym for atomic execution. An accepted interruption may avoid version-state interactions; continuing external writes invalidate that simplification.
configurations.cheaper_path: No imposed long-lived mixed-version operation when genuinely excluded.
configurations.invalidation: Failed conversion/recovery evidence or external writes invalidate this branch.
configurations.member_semantics: Listed criteria contribute under their individual triggers; membership is neither a serial schedule nor a Boolean conjunction of all mechanisms.
configurations.native_guard: An accepted interruption and credible stable write boundary are feasible and preferable to prolonged coexistence.
configurations.native_operation: Rehearse conversion, establish quiescence, reconcile and reopen with accepted returnability or forward-repair limits.

configurations.author_judgment: Phase-out, operational shutdown and archive custody differ. An HTTP hint does not establish actual termination; a useful stable service can remain; a source archive need not be executable.
configurations.cheaper_path: No permanently running obsolete service and no automatic promise that source archives execute.
configurations.invalidation: Unresolved supported consumers or data duties require a revised arrangement; retention can end with its legitimate purpose.
configurations.member_semantics: Listed criteria contribute under their individual triggers; membership is neither a serial schedule nor a Boolean conjunction of all mechanisms.
configurations.native_guard: Continued support/operation is unjustified or infeasible and remaining duties can be resolved.
configurations.native_operation: Transfer or end live responsibilities; retain only the historical artefacts required for a declared future purpose.

configurations.author_judgment: Candidate quality, outcome measurement and action authority remain separate. Correct suggestions can help selected tasks while long-run benefit and general unattended reliability stay unresolved.
configurations.cheaper_path: No duty to use agents or extra human approval for every narrow operation; no self-enlarging authority.
configurations.invalidation: Narrow or disable use when quality, cost, observer or version assumptions fail.
configurations.member_semantics: Listed criteria contribute under their individual triggers; membership is neither a serial schedule nor a Boolean conjunction of all mechanisms.
configurations.native_guard: A supported task class has credible evidence, justified full cost and bounded delegation.
configurations.native_operation: Generate candidates, validate actual effects and authorise the real action; observe outcome quality and displaced work.

configurations.author_judgment: Non-code inclusion is driven by actual consumed effects. Statistical assumptions, code identity and objective authorisation are different; changed inputs do not automatically warrant retraining or a new objective.
configurations.cheaper_path: No ML-specific controls without learned dependencies and no repository-wide policy inventory for unrelated work.
configurations.invalidation: Revalidate affected assumptions, or revise/retire the mechanism within authority; never auto-redefine the goal.
configurations.member_semantics: Listed criteria contribute under their individual triggers; membership is neither a serial schedule nor a Boolean conjunction of all mechanisms.
configurations.native_guard: Data/model/configuration/policy effects are consequential to supported outcomes.

configurations.author_judgment: Restricted servicing is a present capability and value choice. The original staged model makes a strong practical irreversibility claim, but neither that conceptual account nor this successor proves every revival impossible or worthwhile.
configurations.cheaper_path: No universal claim that lost evolution capability is irrecoverable; no indefinite full-feature commitment.
configurations.invalidation: Changed resources, obligations or reconstruction evidence reopen the scope; inability to meet remaining duties can require transition or retirement.
configurations.member_semantics: Listed criteria contribute under their individual triggers; membership is neither a serial schedule nor a Boolean conjunction of all mechanisms.
configurations.native_guard: Full evolution is not presently feasible or worth its cost, but bounded support obligations remain achievable.
configurations.native_operation: Declare the supported correction/security/operational scope and capability limits; keep a route to reassess support, renewed evolution or ending.

induced_rederivations.cost: Persistent cross-tool bindings may cost more than a visible single diff.
induced_rederivations.distinctness: Subject alignment can fail even when each local instrument and model assumption is valid.
induced_rederivations.join: Evidence/action subject, objective and legitimate action must match at a consequential handoff.
induced_rederivations.minimal_witness: CASE-07 has valid evidence for A and action on B.
induced_rederivations.parent_removal: Removing the handoff makes local C033 candidate validation sufficient. Removing a particular implementation such as slicing, refactoring or regression selection does not remove the generic mismatch; those native parent IDs contribute examples rather than universal necessity.
induced_rederivations.subsumption: C005 identity plus C033 validation, if explicitly scoped across every stage and relevant obligation, can already discharge the join. In that setting no new control is warranted.
induced_rederivations.support: Analytical relation and finite witness; not new historical doctrine or integrated field validation.

induced_rederivations.cost: Overbroad invalidation creates rechecking cascades and delays. Irrelevant metadata is a countercontrol.
induced_rederivations.distinctness: C102 may be satisfied while C103 fails: the same object is evaluated under the wrong environment.
essential_roles: Prior evidence with a material premise
induced_rederivations.join: Reused evidence depends on still-applicable assumptions, not only unchanged candidate bytes.
induced_rederivations.minimal_witness: CASE-06 changes the input unit with identical executable identity.
induced_rederivations.parent_removal: Without reuse there is no stale-evidence inference; without a relevant premise change no new recheck follows. C088 tool-version and C092 distribution examples are dispensable specialisations, not mandatory learned-system parents.
induced_rederivations.subsumption: An existing evidence-validity criterion already scoped to the changed premise discharges this relation. Do not duplicate its check under a new name.
induced_rederivations.support: Analytical generalisation supported by model-bound RTS and schema examples; no universal cheap invalidation algorithm.

induced_rederivations.cost: State explosion and unsupported exhaustiveness; choose a consequential abstraction and acknowledge unmodelled reachability.
induced_rederivations.distinctness: Identity and evidence applicability can be correct at both endpoints while a real intermediate state violates an obligation. Recovery capability and eventual closure remain separate, already represented by C049/C058.
essential_roles: More than one interacting state/component change
induced_rederivations.join: Consequential newly reachable combinations have obligations not settled by separate endpoint results.
induced_rederivations.minimal_witness: CASE-01 old/new writer states and CASE-11 merged unit conventions.
induced_rederivations.parent_removal: Remove reachability through genuine quiescence, remove interaction through justified disjointness, or remove the shared observer and the particular witness disappears. There is no requirement that every native parent technique coexist.
induced_rederivations.subsumption: C028 combined-change validation and C057 version-state compatibility already cover their own domains. Retain the general relation only for additional joins; count no extra deployed mechanism when those scopes suffice.
induced_rederivations.support: Analytical generalisation, a finite original witness and scoped primary F1 model; no universal completeness proof.

induced_rederivations.cost: Measuring cost itself consumes resources; rare severe failures and option value make immediate observed payoff an inadequate sole criterion.
induced_rederivations.distinctness: Every local control can help in isolation while the combined cost dominates overlapping protection.
essential_roles: Multiple controls or repeated burden over time
Shared protected outcome or constrained resources
A decision to continue, alter or remove a control
induced_rederivations.join: Combined continuing controls share capacity and can overlap or interfere, so their total burden and protection must be judged jointly.
induced_rederivations.minimal_witness: CASE-09 uses overlapping benefits and additive costs, plus a rare-event countercontrol.
induced_rederivations.parent_removal: With one sufficient low-cost local mechanism and no changed burden the new join adds no extra process. Removing a duplicate control preserves the stipulated benefit in the finite example, but removing all controls may not.
induced_rederivations.subsumption: C064 economics explicitly extended to the full continuing control portfolio can discharge this criterion. It is not an independent optimisation law.
induced_rederivations.support: Analytical comparison with explicit invented case units; no calibrated global optimiser or field effectiveness estimate.

body.open_obligation_judgment: All six canonical open obligations remain open at their exact native scope. Constructed examples demonstrate possibilities but do not estimate integrated benefit, unknown consumers, cheap cross-tool binding, complete joint-state abstraction or general long-run unattended reliability.
